title: This Bird Has a Five-Inch Spike on Each Foot

scenes.text: This bird has a five-inch spike on each foot.
It's the cassowary, from Australia and New Guinea, and it stands up to six and a half feet tall.
It can run 30 miles an hour and leap seven feet off the ground.
Its kick can break bones, which is why Guinness calls it the most dangerous bird.
Five inches of claw, on a bird that's built like a dinosaur.
